avoid: Complex hand holds if too difficult; hold basic hands instead
children.counts: Count 4 marching beats forward and 4 marching beats backward.
children.game_version: Create a musical statues variant where children march in couples and must switch partners when the music pauses.

seniors.counts: March 1-2-3-4 forward, pause/turn on 4, march 1-2-3-4 backward.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm positioning (allemande hold frame) and seated marching foot taps to the 2/4 meter.
seniors.standing_version: Walk forward and backward at a gentle pace without sharp pivot turns or dynamic speed changes.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce marching stride length and select a slower 2/4 march accompaniment.

learning_units.description: Couples march forward anti-clockwise for four bars in allemande hold.
Progressive transfer where ladies move to the partner ahead in the circle between bars 12-13.

social_formats.description: Couples arranged in a circle facing anti-clockwise moving together around the room.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Allemande hold in first eight bars
movement_profile.footwork: Walking and marching steps forward and backward
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couples in a circle around the room facing anti-clockwise, ladies on the right
movement_profile.partnering: Couples in allemande hold; optional partner transition between bars 12-13

signature_moves.description: Couples hold hands in allemande position while marching anti-clockwise.
signature_moves.name: Allemande hold march

signature_moves.description: Ladies move to the partner ahead in the circle between bars 12-13.
signature_moves.name: Progressive shift

music_profile.sound_description: A brisk Scottish march tune set in 2/4 or 4/4 meter. The music features driving accordion or fiddle melodies structured around repeating phrasing ideal for circle walking and turning.

basic_steps: Walk forward anti-clockwise in circle for four bars in allemande hold
Pivot to face clockwise and walk backwards for four bars
Turn lady under arm and set or progress to next partner between bars 12 and 13
teaching.formation: Couples in a circle around the room facing anti-clockwise, ladies on the right
teaching.level_notes: Standard entry-level ceilidh dance suitable for beginners.
